user.title: Add Familyhub
user.description: Create the pairing code in the Familyhub app (as admin) under Meters › Home Assistant › Neue Verbindung koppeln (pair new connection). Tap "Code kopieren" (copy code) there and paste it here.

bestaetigen.title: Check server
bestaetigen.description: Familyhub server: {host}. Is this correct? Your meter readings (encrypted) are sent to this server only. If the address differs, cancel and create the pairing code again.

reauth_bestaetigen.title: Check server
reauth_bestaetigen.description: Familyhub server: {host}. Is this correct? Your meter readings (encrypted) are sent to this server only. If the address differs, cancel and create the pairing code again.

kanaele.title: Assign channels
kanaele.description: Pick the sensor holding the meter reading for each channel (total meter in kWh). At least one channel is required, the others are optional.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair Familyhub
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the connection (token revoked or invalid). Create a new pairing code in the Familyhub app under Meters › Home Assistant › Neue Verbindung koppeln and paste it here.

error.code_format: This is not a valid pairing code. It starts with FH1- and must be pasted completely and unchanged.
error.code_version: This pairing code has an unknown version. Update the integration or the app.
error.code_adresse: The server address in the code is invalid. Only https://hostname is allowed (no path, no IP address).
error.code_token: The token in the code is invalid.
error.code_schluessel: A key in the code has the wrong length.

abort.already_configured: This connection is already set up.

init.title: Familyhub settings
init.description: Change the sensors and the time of the daily upload (local time).

verbindung_ungueltig.title: Familyhub connection invalid
verbindung_ungueltig.description: The server rejected the connection "{name}" (token revoked or invalid). Nothing is sent anymore. Create a new pairing code in the Familyhub app under Meters › Home Assistant › Neue Verbindung koppeln and start re-pairing under Settings › Devices & services › Familyhub.

jetzt_senden.name: Send now
jetzt_senden.description: Reads the sensors now and uploads the readings immediately (for testing).
